macro_risk_events.description: Social inventories of aluminum ingot in Foshan stand at about 180,000 MT, a moderately low level for the year. Primary aluminum smelters in Yunnan are restarting more slowly than expected, so spot supply in South China is tight and the premium is stable.

US tariffs on Chinese aluminum products remain at 25% (Section 232), restricting China's aluminum product exports. However, domestic aluminum ingot circulates mainly within the domestic market, so the direct impact is limited. Watch for future changes to export tax rebate policy.
